history.summary: A 999-year-leasehold 1BR in a small Hougang boutique with effectively flat URA resale appreciation (0.2%/yr) and a thin 17-transaction series. The near-freehold tenure and decent score don't offset weak price momentum, a niche 1BR exit, and a sub-1km MRT walk.
history.rating_rationale: PSF $1,639 sits ~8% above the URA median $1,516, and the resale-only CAGR is essentially zero (0.22%/yr) over 17 txns — no appreciation case. Quasi-freehold tenure is a plus, but a boutique 1BR in D19 Hougang is a shallow-pool exit, and 560m to NE14 is acceptable not strong. Price at $900k keeps it liquid for a starter/investor.
red_flags: Flat resale appreciation (0.22%/yr) over thin 17-txn URA series
Boutique development with niche 1BR resale pool
catalysts: Sub-$1M ticket keeps the unit accessible to upgraders/investors
